findings: In learner.overview, “Early dwelling and household uses are reported” gives no account of why 家 is written with the meaning “house” and the lower sign is immediately presented as an unresolved pictorial or phonetic analysis. State the supported competing constructions first: 宀 is roof/dwelling; the lower element is analyzed either as a pig contributing to a dwelling scene or, in the traditional account, as abbreviated 豭 used for sound. If mentioning early uses, keep their sequence unresolved. Cite 宀’s contribution and the competing lower-element accounts (for example, X-616a47cbc16003181e11, X-3dc220ad74197016529a, X-9208854ef59a2db0fbb0, X-f60f089c38874785bf55).
